snippet.title: Clankers! - Announcement Trailer (Incremental Game)
snippet.description:
Clankers! is a short, incremental robot-killing game. Kill Clankers, gather money, and spend it on weapons and upgrades to stop Clankers from stealing our jobs! 
 
Wishlist Clankers on Steam right now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4111310/Clankers

They're stealing our jobs!
